subject.title: Bug: partialArgs JSON duplication in agentTurn cron jobs with isolated sessionTarget

question: Should malformed tool-call argument repair accept only semantically identical duplicated complete JSON objects, or should OpenClaw change the OpenAI-compatible stream contract more broadly?
rationale: This choice controls how malformed provider output becomes executable file or command tool arguments; automation cannot safely decide whether to discard later structured JSON without maintainer-approved semantics and proof.

options.title: Repair Identical Duplicates
options.body: Accept repeated complete JSON argument objects only when every parsed suffix is semantically identical to the first object, and keep conflicting suffixes fail-closed.

options.title: Broaden Stream Semantics With Proof
options.body: Treat affected provider chunks as cumulative or benign suffixes only after live provider proof and compatibility checks show the later objects are not corrections or conflicting arguments.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed
options.body: Leave duplicated structured suffixes rejected until maintainers accept a narrower repair or obtain stronger live evidence.

recommendation.title: Repair Identical Duplicates
recommendation.body: Accept repeated complete JSON argument objects only when every parsed suffix is semantically identical to the first object, and keep conflicting suffixes fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: The original malformed tool-call argument repair and later helper maintenance history make this the strongest owner signal for the repair-semantics decision.
